subject: Human Evolution
title: Division of Labor
description: A 60-second lesson on Division of Labor.

hook.text: In many hunter-gatherer groups, men hunt large game while women gather plants. Why specialize?

buildup.text: Specialization means each person gets very good at one thing instead of average at everything.

discovery.text: Division of labor multiplies group output: the total harvest exceeds what all-rounders could achieve.

twist.text: The pattern isn't rigid—women hunted in many cultures, and men gathered. Ecology shaped the split.

climax.text: What matters is the principle: cooperation through complementary roles made the group greater than its parts.

quiz.question: Why is division of labor advantageous?
